title: 物性工学
subtitle: Physical Electronics
keywords: Fundamentals of quantum theory 2.Band theory 3.Electrical conduction 4.Dielectric properties 5.Magnetic material
educationalGoal: In the field of optoelectronic devices such as electronic devices and lasers, it is essential to understand material properties. In this course, students learn the basics of their material properties. Specifically, we learn the basics of quantum mechanics, band theory, and understand the behavior of electrons in materials where electric and magnetic fields are present. Furthermore, we will understand the electrical, dielectric, magnetic and optical properties of materials from the atomic and molecular level of microscopic perspective.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) The Schroedinger wave equation can be used to explain the wave function, and energy levels of electrons. (2) Understanding the bonding of crystals allows us to explain the band theory from the possible energy levels of electrons. (3) The movement of electrons in the crystal can be explained using a band diagram. (4) Debye's dispersion equation can be derived and explained for dielectric dispersion and dielectric loss in a dielectric. (5) The local electric field in the dielectric can be described by the Lorentz electric field and the Clausius-Mosotti equation.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Use the Schrodinger wave equation to explain the electron's wave function, orbit and energy levels. (2) The band theory can be explained from the energy levels of electrons in the crystal. (3) The band theory can be used to explain the difference in electric conduction in conductors, semiconductors, and insulators. (4)Be able to explain the difference between Drude's theory and quantum theory about the movement of electrons in crystals. (5) Various dielectric polarization mechanisms can be described from the relationship between electric dipole moment and dielectric dispersion.

lessons.content: Course introduction Crystal bonding (ionic, covalent, metallic), typical crystal structures, etc.
Lattice vibrations in crystals, specific heat of solids, and heat conduction
The movement of electrons in solids (classical electron conduction model)
The fundamentals of quantum mechanics Schrodinger wave equation, well potential, hydrogen atoms, etc
Quiz about contents learned from No.1 to 4 classes.
Review about quiz carried out previous class. The solid energy band theory
The solid energy band theory (Kronig-Penny's model, electron motion in crystals, band structure of metal, semiconductor and insulator)
Semiconductors (intrinsic semiconductors, impurity semiconductors, Hall effect, diodes and transistors)
The optical properties of solids (absorption and reflection of light, photoconductive effects, solar cells, semiconductor lasers)
Quiz about contents learned from No.5 to 9 classes
Review about quiz carried out previous class. Dielectrics (dielectric and polarization, local electric field, mechanism of electric polarization, dielectric dispersion)
Magnetics (magnetic susceptibility and permeability, origin of magnetism, classification of magnetics and their applications)
Superconductors and quantum effects of solids (quantum well structure, superlattice)
